correctness.rationale: For P simple degree-normalized walk on K_{m,n}, P³=P; exact exponential is H_t=rI+B P+C P² with r=e^(−t), B=(1−r²)/2, C=(1−r)²/2. For initial part densities α,β, the heat values at active/inactive vertex types are r+Cα+Bβ and Cα+Bβ (and side-interchanged). If α+β<1, no inactive vertex can cross 1/2; updates delete in at most two simultaneously erasing part-blocks. Complementation covers α+β>1; at =1 all vertices remain fixed. This proves F³=F² for every m,n and t>0, with tie-retain cases. On K2,3 r=3/20 the two initial active values are 2369/4800<1/2 and 2471/4800>1/2 and remaining next value 649/2400<1/2, so exactly two updates are necessary. Stars and K2,2 cannot cascade, giving sharp five-site onset. Rational finite enumeration over 3600 states plus four r samples independently confirmed, but universal proof is structural.
